name: github-utilities
description: Enforces the gh-CLI mandate in GITHUB.md: a Stop hook that blocks turn-end when a GitHub web-API call slipped past gh (curl/wget against api.github.com, `gh api`, WebFetch of github.com), plus gh-issue-rel — the sanctioned wrapper for native sub-issues and blocked-by dependencies, the one gap gh's high-level subcommands leave.
